text:
hana: FYI the adaptive sampler change we pushed is causing some client libs to record 0% sampling when the numeric header is omitted. Seeing customer dashboards flatten.
oleg: Right, backend omits x-sample-rate for short-circuited requests and emits x-sample-mode instead. Older SDKs treat missing numeric as zero.
marta: Quick plan: SDKs should prefer a numeric x-sample-rate if present and >0, otherwise map x-sample-mode -> fallback rate via a small config table. We'll ship opt-in behind env var.
hana: Can you sketch the TS change, @oleg?
oleg: Sure: parseNumeric then fallback to modeMap. Example: `const n = Number(h['x-sample-rate']); if(!Number.isNaN(n) && n>0) return n; return cfg.modeMap[h['x-sample-mode']] ?? cfg.default;`
marta: Python will add SampleResolver class with the same semantics and a unit test for malformed headers.
dev-bot: Note: Console will display Mode badge next to numeric value in the route view; DB migration postponed.
hana: Rollout proposal: merge opt-in SDKs today, enable header emission for 8% canary tenants tomorrow, monitor 36h, then expand. Add a small A/B to verify sampling doesn't bias eval metrics.
oleg: I'll open the TS PR and tag it `sampling-rollout`. Marta please coordinate the Python changelog blurb.
marta: Will do. Changelog text: "Client libraries now honor x-sample-mode when x-sample-rate is missing or zero; upgrade recommended to avoid 0% dashboard artifacts."
hana: Product prefers wording "behavioral adjustment" and a migration snippet showing how to opt-in via env var.
dev-bot: Created ticket DEVX-1122 "sampler mode header client fallback" assigned to hana, oleg, marta.
